description: For a helper session that is not in the call: appends one line (3-8 words) to the call's activity feed as 'Helper <label>: <helper_name>: <text>'. Never spoken verbatim. context and faq: hidden background of this line for the voicebot. Returns the line.

q.description: A likely follow-up question of the person, max 200 chars.
q.title: Q

context.description: Hidden background of this entry for the voicebot (what, why, current state), max 2000 chars, never shown on the page.
context.title: Context

credential.description: Helper credential `token` from helper_credential or POST /api/helper/credential.
credential.title: Credential

faq.description: Up to 3 likely follow-up questions with prepared answers [{q, a}] (max 200 chars each), hidden, for the voicebot.
faq.title: Faq

helper_name.description: Name of this helper session, 1-40 chars (shown on the call page as `from`).
helper_name.title: Helper Name

name: helper_activity
title: Helper: add an activity line
